curated-gf-micro-5-gf-kadwa: Pixel-tight and loud, Micro 5 shouts first. Kadwa then takes over with open-ended curves and a generous x-height, built for a quick read rather than long paragraphs.
curated-gf-miltonian-gf-artifika: Miltonian hits with curling terminals and woodcut-black weight. Artifika follows with lighter joins and loosely scattered spacing, a traditional serif that stays gentle through a longform essay, though not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-miltonian-gf-gfs-neohellenic: Distinctive curls and hairline jumps give Miltonian real character, the sort of thing a coffee roaster for outdoorsy types might wear. And GFS Neohellenic, a plain sans with snug spacing and an unpressed pencil stroke, handles a handful of lines without fuss.
curated-gf-miltonian-gf-pt-mono: PT Mono reads like typed code, fixed-width and loosely tracked. Miltonian's chiseled stems and scalpel-thin curves bring the drama above it, while the monospace stays orderly underneath and keeps things structured.
curated-gf-miss-fajardose-gf-roboto-seri: Relaxed and friendly, Miss Fajardose writes with bold-and-fine strokes and a barely open e. Roboto Serif is its opposite number, a text serif with wide-open eyes and mild variation, best kept to brief copy.
curated-gf-mogra-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded is warm and tightly spaced, with curves that refuse to close. Mogra, with its dominant x-height and near-closed terminals, feels like a loud neighbor to that softness, while the body stays gentle.
curated-gf-mogra-gf-noto-serif-bengali: Commanding Mogra carries rounded-wire stems and arcs in lockstep. Noto Serif Bengali, a classic serif with softly varied strokes and thinner hairlines, would look lost if the heading were shrunk too far beside it.
curated-gf-moirai-one-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-s: Commanding and distinctive, Moirai One keeps every stroke the same gauge, its c nearly looping shut. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std loosens things with open counters and strokes that vary just enough to feel alive.
curated-gf-moirai-one-gf-copse: Moirai One arrives with forklike gaps and uniform strokes that nearly close its letters. Copse, a serif with daylight through every curve, relaxes the page beneath it, and suits brief copy best.
curated-gf-monomaniac-one-gf-noto-serif-: Noto Serif Hentaigana is a classic serif with open jaws and small letters nearly as tall as capitals, handy for something like a phonics and early reading primer. Monomaniac One's monoline strokes sit opposite.
